Re-review fixes: keep TTL from created_at; stable completion time on read (#15)

- Revert created_at=start: TTL expiry counts from created_at, so a job longer
  than its TTL was expired the moment it finished. The duration question
  goes to #20.
- FileSystemStore._deserialize restores the stored completed_at instead of
  letting __post_init__ stamp the read time.
- on_error overrides are annotated BaseException like the protocol.
